method.branch: main, every commit reachable from HEAD (merges included)
method.date_used: author date, converted to Mountain time (America/Denver), where Ben lives
commands: a commit counts as Claude co-authored when its message has a line starting 'Co-Authored-By:' that contains 'Claude'
platform first appearance: git log --diff-filter=A --reverse -- <path> for the platform's folder or manifest, cross-checked against commit subjects
notes: Counting by UTC instead of Mountain time gives 4,302 commits through September 30. Earlier template pages quote 4,285 and 4,298, counted on other days with other cutoffs.
Store dates come from public store data gathered 2026-10-01 (App Store) or from the commit that recorded a listing going live. They are marked with their source.
